audit_stopping: First nominal conflict before other checks; otherwise budget or catalogue exhaustion. Nominal or expanded claim terminality never ends an audit early
budget_censoring: Choose independently of remaining funds; if the next action is unaffordable stop without reranking
budget_rule: floor(percent * original unqueried catalogue cost at H0 / 100); base acquisition is sunk and separately reported
certificate_cache: Key by correct model/contract and ordered paid history; verify distinct certificates once and every run reference
closure_informed: Fixed saved k=2 distinct signatures compatible with paid H; maximize positive count of signatures whose answer empties nominal support divided by action cost, ties lower cost then opaque ID; zero-score fallback constant_first
conflict_output: nominal_model_conflict with nominal certificate and withheld definite conclusion; no causal or claim-falsity assertion
constant_first: Recompute nominal partition after each paid answer; cheapest unqueried one-nonempty-branch action first, else cheapest unqueried action; ties opaque ID
cost_order: Ascending (cost, opaque query ID) among unqueried actions
failure_handling: Preserve failed/capped cells and valid outputs; no truncation, substitution, new mechanisms, or silent refreeze
label: Review-informed audit ordering after preserved nominal stopping; known baseline outcomes, no new evaluation outcomes before freeze
no_alarm_output: no_conflict_observed with coverage; no model adequacy claim
no_audit: Preserve H0 and its nominal proposal; zero added cost at every audit budget
paired_comparison: constant_first minus cost_order per problem; closure_informed comparisons labeled extra-model-knowledge separately
policy_information_boundary: No realized signature, omitted IDs, parent provenance, realized truth, full-archive conflict category, actual evaluation k, future answers, or remaining budget enters selection
runtime_measurement: Aggregate local planning and checking overhead only; distinct from abstract retrieval units, no timing competition
sampling_inference: None; no confidence intervals, p-values, or independent incident claims
signature_weighting: Exact descriptive within-problem signature census; no new deployment prior
support_semantics: Evaluate every world in the saved actual Mk compatible with the same final paid evidence; retain claim and operational statuses separately; withdrawal never counts as warrant restoration
